SELECT p.post_id, u.user_nickname, p.post_title, p.post_type, p.post_view_number FROM ch_post p LEFT JOIN ch_user u ON u.user_id = p.post_user_id AND u.user_is_delete = 0 WHERE p.post_is_delete = 0
AND p.post_type = #{postType}
AND p.post_title LIKE CONCAT(#{postTitle}, '%')
AND (p.create_time > #{cursorTime} OR (p.create_time = #{cursorTime} AND p.post_id > #{cursorId}))
AND (p.create_time < #{cursorTime} OR (p.create_time = #{cursorTime} AND p.post_id < #{cursorId}))
ORDER BY p.create_time ASC, p.post_id ASC
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC, p.post_id DESC
LIMIT #{pageSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE ch_post SET post_view_number = post_view_number + 1 WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND post_is_delete = 0
